title: Certified Production Recovery live-authority and approved execution gate

phases.objective: Validate explicit Hostinger Production server-managed binding intent against the canonical Recovery authority graph while keeping direct caller construction and incomplete or uncertified Production activation fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Direct production_live construction is rejected. A deployment-owned Production candidate remains fail-closed when live authorization is incomplete and can become activation-eligible only through the server-managed provider path when the complete exact-SHA, independent-evidence, approval-resolution, and readback contract is certified.
steps: Resolve runtime identity and accept Production intent only for explicit production_hostinger_autodeploy.
Load the deployment-owned server-managed binding resolver without accepting caller, GPT, Local Connector, raw SQL, or secret-bearing envelope fields.
Validate the complete adapter graph using the canonical Recovery composition contract.
Reject direct production_live construction and return fail-closed composition for missing or incomplete live authorization.

Permit activation eligibility only for a server-managed envelope that certifies exact SHA, single-use approval, server-side approval resolution, target-database-independent bootstrap evidence, independent role-aware same-cycle readback, and the complete authority graph.

Evaluate candidate component status against signed staging certification, exact Production deployment attestation, target fingerprint, artifact parity, typed adapter provenance, and unresolved-incident gates.
Assert no caller/GPT credential or direct provider authority can manufacture live authorization.
assertions: generic or ambiguous Production runtime cannot request a candidate
only explicit hostinger_autodeploy can carry production_live intent
direct production_live construction is explicitly forbidden
incomplete or uncertified candidates remain fail-closed

certified server-managed activation eligibility requires exact SHA, single-use approval, server-side approval resolution, independent bootstrap evidence, and independent role-aware same-cycle readback
staging and production are both explicitly declared and live staging certification remains required
database_mutation_performed=false during composition and certification evaluation
provider_mutation_performed=false during composition and certification evaluation

phases.objective: Expose a verified-admin approved-step bridge that keeps approval tokens and execution-ticket material server-side, breaks the empty runtime_persistence bootstrap evidence deadlock with an independent Recovery Store, and preserves exact-SHA, single-use, fenced, same-cycle-readback execution semantics without performing a live Production mutation in this PR.

e2e_journeys.actor: Verified administrator on the private Production Recovery surface
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The challenge returns a plan/step/SHA-bound typed confirmation phrase but no approval token. After the administrator types that exact phrase, the server resolves approval material internally, issues the execution ticket internally, executes only through the existing governed Host Breakglass boundary, requires independent same-cycle readback, and returns a sanitized receipt with neither token nor ticket material.
steps: Resolve the immutable plan and consequential step and create a short-lived approval challenge.
Return exact typed-confirmation requirements bound to approval_id, plan_hash, step_id, and exact Production SHA without returning approval-token material.
Validate the typed confirmation and resolve the approved token only through the server-owned approval authority.
Issue and reserve the existing single-use execution ticket internally; caller ticket fields remain forbidden.
Require an independent target-database-free Recovery Store before runtime_persistence bootstrap authority can become eligible.
Execute only through the existing fenced Recovery/Host Breakglass boundary and require independent role-aware same-cycle readback before finalization.
assertions: No caller-visible response contains the approval token, execution-ticket ID, ticket hash, signature, credential, raw SQL, or provider secret.
Wrong, expired, used, cross-plan, cross-step, or cross-SHA confirmation fails before ticket issuance or provider execution.
Direct caller construction of production_live remains forbidden.

A server-managed Production candidate is activation-eligible only when exact-SHA, single-use approval, same-cycle readback, server-side approval resolution, and target-database-independent bootstrap evidence are explicitly certified.
A Recovery store coupled to runtime_persistence cannot authorize the runtime_persistence bootstrap path.

The existing selected-role rebuild contract remains responsible for proving zero objects, allowlisted role identity, repository-bound role bundle checksums, sequential execution, and post-mutation readback.
This PR performs no Production database mutation, grant apply, migration apply, deployment, Hostinger action, credential read, or live provider call.

phases.objective: Keep actual Production execution blocked until exact deployment evidence proves activation_eligible and each consequential recovery step receives the required explicit human authorization and same-cycle readback authority.
